annual.label: Estimated yearly maintenance, midpoint of $250–540 (Recharged 5-year estimate ÷ 5, about 15,000 mi/yr)

maint.every: Often 60,000–90,000 miles thanks to regenerative braking
maint.note: Recharged puts a front brake job at about $350–700. Check pads and slide pins in salty climates.
Light use can let rotors rust, a common reason to replace them early.

maint.every: Around 60,000 miles per Hyundai's schedule (check the owner's manual)
maint.note: Uses separate coolant loops for the battery, motor and charger; best done by a Hyundai EV-certified shop.
